name: G.ERR.03

name: G.CTL.02

name: G.CTL.01

name: G.OTH.03

name: Redundant casts and non-null assertions should be avoided
good: declare const value: number | undefined; const same = value!;

name: Unused assignments should be removed
bad: function f(){ let value=1; value=2; return value; }
good: function f(){ let value=1; return value; }

name: Related "if/else if" statements should not have the same condition
"super()" should be invoked appropriately
good: class Child extends Parent { constructor() { super(); } }

name: "catch" clauses should do more than rethrow
good: try { run(); } catch (error) { log(error); throw error; }

name: Sparse arrays should not be declared
Jump statements should not occur in "finally" blocks
bad: function f(){ try { return 1; } finally { return 2; } }
good: function f(){ try { return 1; } finally { cleanup(); } }

name: Comma operator should not be used
"NaN" should not be used in comparisons
Variables and functions should not be redeclared
Wrapper objects should not be used for primitive types
Union and intersection types should not be defined with duplicated elements
Boolean expressions should not be gratuitous
Destructuring patterns should not be empty
"default" clauses should be last
bad: switch(x){ default: run(); break; case 1: stop(); }
good: switch(x){ case 1: run(); break; default: stop(); }

name: "await" should only be used with promises
Redundant pairs of parentheses should be removed
Constructors should not be declared inside interfaces
Multiline string literals should not be used
Non-empty statements should change control flow or have at least one side-effect
Nested blocks of code should not be left empty
Identical expressions should not be used on both sides of a binary operator
Variables declared with "var" should be declared before they are used
Debugger statements should not be used
"delete" should not be used on arrays
A compare function should be provided when using "Array.prototype.sort()"
Loops with at most one iteration should be refactored
bad: for(const value of values) { run(value); break; }

name: Array-mutating methods should not be used misleadingly
Types without members, 'any' and 'never' should not be used in type intersections
"in" should not be used on arrays
bad: const values=[1,2]; for(const key in values) { run(key); }
good: const values={a:1}; for(const key in values) { run(key); }

name: All branches in a conditional structure should not have exactly the same implementation
Function parameters, caught exceptions and foreach variables' initial values should not be ignored
bad: function f(value: number){ value=1; return value; }

name: The output of functions that don't return anything should not be used
Conditionals should start on new lines
Boolean checks should not be inverted
Values should not be uselessly incremented
bad: function f(){ let value=0; return value++; }

name: Parameters should be passed in the correct order
Functions should not have identical implementations
bad: function first(){ return 1; } function second(){ return 1; }
good: function first(){ return 1; } function second(){ return 2; }

name: "switch" statements should not have too many "case" clauses
bad: switch(value){case 0: break;case 1: break;case 2: break;case 3: break;case 4: break;case 5: break;case 6: break;case 7: break;case 8: break;case 9: break;case 10: break;case 11: break;case 12: break;case 13: break;case 14: break;case 15: break;case 16: break;case 17: break;case 18: break;case 19: break;case 20: break;case 21: break;case 22: break;case 23: break;case 24: break;case 25: break;case 26: break;case 27: break;case 28: break;case 29: break;case 30: break;}
good: switch(value){case 0: break;case 1: break;case 2: break;case 3: break;case 4: break;case 5: break;case 6: break;case 7: break;case 8: break;case 9: break;case 10: break;case 11: break;case 12: break;case 13: break;case 14: break;case 15: break;case 16: break;case 17: break;case 18: break;case 19: break;case 20: break;case 21: break;case 22: break;case 23: break;case 24: break;case 25: break;case 26: break;case 27: break;case 28: break;case 29: break;}

name: Comma and logical OR operators should not be used in switch cases
A "while" loop should be used instead of a "for" loop
Function returns should not be invariant
Collection elements should not be replaced unconditionally
bad: const values=[1,2]; for(const value of values) { values[0]=value; }

name: Non-existent operators '=+', '=-' and '=!' should not be used
Promise rejections should not be caught by 'try' block
bad: function f(){ try { return Promise.reject(new Error()); } catch(e) { log(e); } }
good: async function f(){ try { return await Promise.reject(new Error()); } catch(e) { log(e); } }

name: Errors should not be created without being thrown
Empty collections should not be accessed or iterated
Collection sizes and array length comparisons should make sense
Collection and array contents should be used
Getters and setters should access the expected fields
bad: class Example { _name=""; _age=0; get name(){ return this._age; } }
good: class Example { _name=""; get name(){ return this._name; } }

name: Return values from functions without side effects should not be ignored
"undefined" should not be passed as the value of optional parameters
Two branches in a conditional structure should not have exactly the same implementation
bad: if(a) { run(); } else if(b) { stop(); } else { run(); }
good: if(a) { run(); } else if(b) { stop(); } else { wait(); }

name: Multiline blocks should be enclosed in curly braces
"switch" statements should have at least 3 "case" clauses
bad: switch(value){case 1: run(); break; case 2: stop(); break;}
good: switch(value){case 1: run(); break; case 2: stop(); break; case 3: wait(); break;}

name: Boolean literals should not be used in comparisons
bad: declare const ready:boolean; if(ready === true) run();

name: opening braces independent of else placement
array membership versus object membership
bad: const values=[1,2]; const found=1 in values;
good: const values={one:1}; const found="one" in values;

name: boolean versus coercion-sensitive union
bad: declare const ready:boolean; if(false === ready) run();
good: declare const ready:boolean | undefined; if(ready === false) run();

name: string contents remain significant
bad: function a(){return "a b";} function b(){return "a b";}

name: visible mutation removes empty-array warning
bad: const items:number[]=[]; for(const item of items) run(item);
good: const items:number[]=[]; fill(items); for(const item of items) run(item);

name: TODO inside string is not comment
copyright text must be header comment
same-spelling shadow does not mutate outer array
good: const values=[1,2]; for(const x of values){const values=[]; values.push(x);}
